q: Ratner's theorems on orbit closures and equidistribution for unipotent flows on homogeneous spaces include the measure classification theorem, which states that every ergodic U-invariant probability measure on Γ\G (G Lie, Γ lattice, U unipotent) is:
opts: An algebraic measure: the U-invariant measure on a closed orbit Γ\ΓgH for some closed subgroup H ≤ G
exp: Ratner's measure classification (1991): every ergodic U-invariant (U = unipotent one-parameter subgroup) probability measure μ on Γ\G is the L-invariant measure on a closed orbit xL for some closed connected subgroup L ≥ U. This is the 'algebraicity' of limits of translates by unipotent flows.
